---
title: "Lesson 2: Tangent Spaces"
---

## Overview

Tangent spaces describe the first-order linear approximation of a manifold at a point.

## Intuition

At a point on a curve or surface, the tangent space captures the possible directions of motion. It is the best linear model near that point.

## Formal Definition

For a manifold $M$ at a point $p$, the tangent space $T_pM$ consists of equivalence classes of curves through $p$.

$$
T_pM \cong \mathbb{R}^n
$$

## Examples

- The tangent space to $\mathbb{R}^n$ is itself.
- The tangent line to a circle at a point.
- The tangent plane to a sphere at a point.
